<<pre id="VALwasm_detection_script" class="ocsforge_color odocwiki_code"|<<span class="ocsforge_color_keyword"|val>> <<span class="odocwiki_name"|wasm~_detection~_script>> <<span class="ocsforge_color_delimiter"|~:>> <<span class="odocwiki_type"|\\  <<span class="ocsforge_color_label"| ?defer: >>bool <<span class="ocsforge_color_delimiter"| -> >>\\  <<span class="ocsforge_color_label"| ?async: >>bool <<span class="ocsforge_color_delimiter"| -> >>\\  <<span class="ocsforge_color_label"| ?js_name: >>string <<span class="ocsforge_color_delimiter"| -> >>\\  <<span class="ocsforge_color_label"| ?wasm_name: >>string <<span class="ocsforge_color_delimiter"| -> >> unit <<span class="ocsforge_color_delimiter"| -> >> [> `Script ] <<a_api subproject="server" text="Content.Html.elt" | type Content.Html.elt >>>>>><<div class="odocwiki_info"|~The function <<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|wasm~_detection~_script ~(~)>> returns an inline <<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|~<script~>>> node
      that automatically detects ~Web~Assembly support in the browser and
      dynamically loads the appropriate version of the application~.


      ~When the browser supports ~Web~Assembly with ~G~C
      ~(<<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|window~?~.~Web~Assembly~?~.~J~S~Tag>> is defined~, which is required by
      wasm~_of~_ocaml~)~, it loads the ~W~A~S~M version ~(<<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|~.wasm~.js>>~)~. ~Otherwise~,
      it falls back to the ~Java~Script version ~(<<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|~.js>>~)~.


      ~This function is automatically used by ~Eliom when ~Web~Assembly support is
      enabled ~(see <<a_api subproject="server" | val Config.set_enable_wasm >>~)~. ~The generated script
      creates a <<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|~<script~>>> element dynamically with the appropriate <<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|src>>
      attribute and appends it to the document head~.
>>
<<div class="odocwiki_param_info"|<<span class="code"|defer>> : ~If <<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|true>>~, sets the <<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|defer>> attribute on the dynamically
                   created script tag~. ~Default comes from the site~'s
                   <<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|application~_script>> configuration~.>>
<<div class="odocwiki_param_info"|<<span class="code"|async>> : ~If <<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|true>>~, sets the <<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|async>> attribute on the dynamically
                   created script tag~. ~Default comes from the site~'s
                   <<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|application~_script>> configuration~.>>
<<div class="odocwiki_param_info"|<<span class="code"|js_name>> : ~Optional filename for the ~Java~Script fallback version~.
                     ~Useful for specifying cache~-busting hashed filenames~.
                     ~Default is <<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|application~_name ~^ "~.js">>~.>>
<<div class="odocwiki_param_info"|<<span class="code"|wasm_name>> : ~Optional filename for the ~Web~Assembly version~.
                       ~Useful for specifying cache~-busting hashed filenames~.
                       ~Default is <<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|application~_name ~^ "~.wasm~.js">>~.


      //~Warning~: ~Like <<a_api subproject="server" | val Registration.APP.application_script >>~, do not manually include this
